title: Inline $$ mid-sentence
paper_summary: The loss $$\mathcal{L} = \sum_i \ell_i$$ is minimised jointly.

title: Aligned rows
paper_summary:
We optimise two objectives.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{L}_{\text{total}} &= \mathcal{L}_{\text{rec}} + \lambda \mathcal{L}_{\text{kl}} \\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{kl}} &= D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q(z \mid x) \,\|\, p(z))
\end{aligned}
$$

Both terms are weighted.

title: Underscores inside text commands
paper_summary: The schedule sets $\text{lr_max} = 3 \times 10^{-4}$ and $\eta_{\text{warm_up}} = 0.1$.

title: Percent and ampersand
paper_summary: Accuracy rises by $12\%$ (and by $50%$ on hard cases); $A \& B$ and $P & Q$ are datasets. Plain prose: 30% & more.

title: Nested braces
paper_summary: The estimator is $\hat{\mu} = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} w_i^{2} x_{i}}{\sqrt{\sum_{j=1}^{n} w_j^{2}}}$.

title: Escaped braces
paper_summary: The vocabulary is $V = \{v_1, \dots, v_n\}$ and $\left\{ x \mid x > 0 \right\}$.

title: Unicode symbols
paper_summary: For $α + β ≤ γ$ we get a 3× speed-up and ≥ 95% recall → better results, naïve baselines.

title: Long display equation
paper_summary:
The full objective:

$$
\mathcal{L}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{x \sim p_{\text{data}}}\left[\log D_\phi(x)\right] + \mathbb{E}_{z \sim p(z)}\left[\log\left(1 - D_\phi(G_\theta(z))\right)\right] + \lambda_1 \|\theta\|_2^2 + \lambda_2 \sum_{k=1}^{K} \mathrm{KL}\left(q_k \,\|\, p_k\right) + \gamma \cdot \mathrm{TV}(G_\theta)
$$

This is long on purpose.

title: Long inline equation
paper_summary: Inline: $\mathcal{L}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{x\sim p_{\text{data}}}[\log D_\phi(x)]+\mathbb{E}_{z\sim p(z)}[\log(1-D_\phi(G_\theta(z)))]+\lambda_1\|\theta\|_2^2+\lambda_2\sum_{k=1}^{K}\mathrm{KL}(q_k\|p_k)$ ends here.
